hook.en: A register in the office is taken out, written in, and put back. A Python file is handled the same way: open it, use it, close it.
hook.kn: ಕಚೇರಿಯ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್ ತೆಗೆದು, ಬರೆದು, ಮತ್ತೆ ಇಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಕಡತವನ್ನೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ: ತೆರೆ, ಬಳಸು, ಮುಚ್ಚು.

objectives.en: Use open() with the correct access mode

narration.en: A register in the office is taken out, written in, and put back. A Python file is handled the same way: open it, use it, close it.
narration.kn: ಕಚೇರಿಯ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್ ತೆಗೆದು, ಬರೆದು, ಮತ್ತೆ ಇಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಕಡತವನ್ನೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ: ತೆರೆ, ಬಳಸು, ಮುಚ್ಚು.

body.en: file_object = open(file_name, access_mode) returns a file object (file handle) that links the program to the file. The access mode says what we will do and where the file offset starts. The file object has attributes such as name, mode and closed.

points.en: 'r': read only, offset at beginning (default); file must exist
'w': write only; existing contents overwritten, new file created if absent; beginning
'a': append; new data written at the end; file created if absent
'a+': append and read; offset at end

narration.en: file_object = open(file_name, access_mode) returns a file object (file handle) that links the program to the file. The access mode says what we will do and where the file offset starts. The file object has attributes such as name, mode and closed.
narration.kn: open(file_name, access_mode) ಒಂದು ಕಡತ ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಕ್ಸೆಸ್ ಮೋಡ್ ನಾವು ಏನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: After use, file_object.close() frees the memory given to the file and writes any unsaved data to it. If the file object is reassigned to another file, Python closes the earlier one automatically. The with clause, with open(name, mode) as f:, closes the file automatically when the block ends, even if an exception occurs, so it is the preferred style.

points.en: No explicit close() needed inside with

narration.en: After use, file_object.close() frees the memory given to the file and writes any unsaved data to it. If the file object is reassigned to another file, Python closes the earlier one automatically. The with clause, with open(name, mode) as f:, closes the file automatically when the block ends, even if an exception occurs, so it is the preferred style.
narration.kn: ಬಳಕೆಯ ನಂತರ close() ಕಡತ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉಳಿದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. with ಉಪವಾಕ್ಯ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಮುಗಿದಾಗ ಕಡತವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ದೋಷ ಬಂದರೂ ಸಹ.

points.en: close() or a with block releases the file.

homework.en: Make a table of the access modes r, rb, r+, w, wb+, a, a+ with the offset position for each.

narration.en: Recap. open(name, mode) returns a file object; the default mode is r. w overwrites, a appends at the end, r needs an existing file. close() or a with block releases the file.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. open(name, mode) ಕಡತ ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಡೀಫಾಲ್ಟ್ ಮೋಡ್ r. w ಅಳಿಸಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, a ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, r ಗೆ ಕಡತ ಇರಬೇಕು. close() ಅಥವಾ with ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಕಡತವನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.
